title: Sega Screams Volume 2
overview:
Sega Screams Volume 2 is a demo disc for the Sega Saturn, released exclusively in North America with console bundles. It is a "sequel" to Sega Screams Volume 1. It is less common than its predecessor.

Playable demos:
• Die Hard Arcade (1996-11-12 demo)
• Saturn Bomberman (1997-02-24 demo)
• AMOK (1996 demo)
• Scorcher (1996 demo)
